title: Regulatory plasticity of the human genome
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习模型分析基因组突变驱动的增强子周转，涉及转录因子结合位点与细胞类型特异性调控，但核心是调控元件进化而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移但对象和互作深度有限。
abstract: Evolutionary turnover in non-coding regions has driven phenotypic divergence during past speciation events and continues to facilitate environmental adaptation through variants. We used a deep learning model to identify the substrates of regulatory turnover using genome wide mutations mimicking three evolutionary pathways: recent history (human-chimp substitutions), modern population (human population variation), and mutational susceptibility (random mutations). We observed enhancer turnover in approximately 6% of the whole genome, with more than 80% of the novel activity arising from repurposing of enhancers between cell-types. Frequency of turnover in a cell-type is remarkably similar across the three pathways, despite only ∼19% overlap in the source regions. The enhancers predisposed to turnover display reduced evolutionary constraints and are depleted in GWAS variants. Most of these occur within 100kb of a gene, with the highest turnover occurring near neurodevelopmental genes including CNTNAP2, NPAS3, and AUTS2. Flanking enhancers of these genes undergo high turnover irrespective of the mutational model pathway, suggesting a high plasticity in neurocognitive evolution. Based on susceptibility to random mutations, these enhancers were identified as vulnerable by nature and feature a higher abundance of cell type-specific transcription factor binding sites (TFBSs). Our findings suggest that enhancer repurposing within vulnerable loci drives regulatory innovation while keeping the core regulatory networks intact.
abstract_zh: 非编码区域的进化更替在过去物种形成事件中驱动了表型分化，并持续通过变异促进环境适应。我们使用深度学习模型，通过模拟三种进化路径的全基因组突变来识别调控更替的底物：近期历史（人-黑猩猩替换）、现代群体（人类群体变异）和突变易感性（随机突变）。我们观察到全基因组中约6%的区域存在增强子更替，其中超过80%的新活性源于增强子在细胞类型间的重新利用。尽管源区域仅有约19%的重叠，但三种路径中细胞类型特异性的更替频率却惊人地相似。倾向于更替的增强子表现出降低的进化约束，并在GWAS变异中富集程度较低。这些增强子大多位于基因100kb范围内，其中最高更替率出现在神经发育基因附近，包括CNTNAP2、NPAS3和AUTS2。这些基因的侧翼增强子无论突变模型路径如何均经历高更替率，表明神经认知进化具有高度可塑性。基于对随机突变的易感性，这些增强子被识别为天然脆弱的，并具有更高丰度的细胞类型特异性转录因子结合位点（TFBSs）。我们的发现表明，脆弱位点内的增强子重新利用驱动调控创新，同时保持核心调控网络完整。
